'''Chris Revenaugh''' introduced [[Mitch Velasco]] to Star Wars CCG: around 1995 Revenaugh, a player local to Velasco, bought a [[Premiere]] sealed deck and, not wanting to learn the game alone, asked Velasco to learn it with him.<ref name="pc-mitchbio">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/MitchBio.htm Meet Mitch Velasco, New Tournaments Advocate!], swccgpc.com (2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20031209102036/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/MitchBio.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
